summary: Onboarding operator (Issue #15): AI-operated onboarding over the gated engine. The operator (actor_kind system) may record a stage advance ONLY on a plain PASS result and only into routine stages (normalize, source_controls, snapshot, activity_bridge, preflight); never on a waived FAIL/BLOCKED and never into execute. Replaces CHECK onboarding_events_human_gates, onboarding_stage_events_validate and conversion_batches_onboarding_guard accordingly; adds onboarding_auto_advance (system only, PASS only). Waivers, approvals and EXECUTE stay human / owner only. No rows change. service_role only.

preflight.name: operator advance function does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'onboarding_auto_advance'

preflight.name: 484 bridge tables are in place
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'onboarding_bridge_items'

expected_changes: Replaces CHECK onboarding_events_human_gates (stage_advanced may also be actor_kind system).
Replaces onboarding_stage_events_validate (system advance only on a PASS result into routine stages) and conversion_batches_onboarding_guard (re-proves it; execute still needs a human).
